title: Viral RNA Extraction using MagMAX Kit
author: Erika Bujaki
materials: Clean reagents should be prepared in a separate clean area away from the samples. Carefully consider the number of samples to be processed, depending on the extraction workflow used. Wash Solutions only need to be prepared once and can be used until exhausted.

steps.title: Prepare Wash Solution 1
steps.instruction: Prepare Wash Solution 1 by adding the indicated volume of 100% Isopropanol to the Wash Solution 1 Concentrate bottle.

substeps.instruction: Mix well by inverting at least 5 times.
Mark the bottle to indicate alcohol was added.
Store at the temperature shown on the label.

steps.title: Prepare Wash Solution 2
steps.instruction: Prepare Wash Solution 2 by adding the indicated volume of 100% ethanol to the Wash Solution 2 Concentrate bottle.

substeps.instruction: Mix well by inverting at least 5 times.
Mark the bottle to indicate ethanol was added.
Store at the temperature shown on the label.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis/Binding Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the Lysis/Binding Solution for the required number of samples, including controls and extra for pipetting loss.

substeps.instruction: Combine components in the indicated order.
Add Carrier RNA to Lysis/Binding Solution Concentrate and mix briefly.
Add 100% Isopropanol and mix well by vortexing.

steps.title: Prepare Bead Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the bead mix on the day of use, ensuring enough volume for all samples plus pipetting loss.

substeps.instruction: Vortex nucleic acid binding beads well to ensure full resuspension.
Combine components and mix well by vortexing.
Store in the fridge or on ice for up to 4 hours; do not freeze.

steps.title: Perform Sample Lysis
steps.instruction: Perform sample lysis in a dedicated sample handling area using 5 mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind microcentrifuge tubes (or sterile 15 mL conical bottom centrifuge tubes).

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 2.4 ml of the prepared Lysis/Binding solution (supplemented with carrier RNA and 100% Isopropanol) into labeled tubes.
Add 1.2 ml of sewage concentrate samples to the tubes, immersing pipette tips slightly in the solution to prevent aerosols and rinsing the tip.
Mix gently by vortexing for 30s and spin briefly to collect tube content.

steps.title: Manual RNA Extraction (Bead Capture and Washes)
steps.instruction: Perform manual extraction of RNA using magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 60 μl of prepared bead mix to each sample tube using a new tip for every addition, rinsing the tip with sample solution.
Mix thoroughly at gentle speed for 4 min (via shaker, rotator, or manual vortexing) until the mixture is visibly homogenous.
Place tubes on a magnet for at least 3 minutes until beads form a pellet.
Aspirate and discard supernatant; centrifuge briefly if necessary to remove all lysis supernatant.
Wash 1: Add 300 µl Wash Solution 1 (with Isopropanol), vortex at moderate speed for 30s, centrifuge briefly, capture on magnet for 3-5 min, and discard supernatant. Repeat this wash once more.
Wash 2: Add 450 µl Wash Solution 2 (with ethanol), vortex at moderate speed for 30s, centrifuge briefly, capture on magnet for 3-5 min, and discard supernatant. Repeat this wash once more.
Dry beads by centrifuging briefly, removing residual solution with a fine-tipped pipette, and leaving the tube open for 2 minutes to evaporate alcohol.

steps.title: Manual RNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL Elution Buffer to each sample and shake/vortex vigorously for 4 min until pellet resuspends.
Centrifuge briefly to collect content.
Place open tubes on the magnet and collect the clear supernatant containing purified RNA into labeled containers.
Keep RNA on ice for immediate use or store frozen.

steps.title: Automated Extraction: KingFisher Duo Prime Setup
steps.instruction: Configure the KingFisher Duo Prime for large volume sample extraction using a 12-tip magnetic head and 6-tip combs.

substeps.instruction: Import the MVRI_Duo_LV_1200ul program and perform a mock run.
Verify the 6-tip magnet and heating block are installed; use the 'Change Magnetic Head' maintenance protocol if replacement is needed.
Run the 'Check 12/6 tip' protocol with a dummy test plate to ensure correct positioning.

steps.title: Automated Extraction: KingFisher Duo Prime Plate Prep
steps.instruction: Prepare 24 deep-well plates in the clean reagent handling area.

substeps.instruction: Label plates as 'Sample plate' and 'Elution plate'.
Add 900 μl of Wash Solution 1 to rows B and C of the Sample Plate.
Place a 12-tip comb in row D of the Sample Plate.
Add 1350 μl of Wash Solution 2 to rows A and B of the Elution Plate.
Add 90 μl of Elution Buffer or nuclease free water to row D of the Elution Plate.
Transfer 3.6 ml of sample/lysis mixture to row A of the Sample Plate.
Add 60 μl of Bead Mix to row A of the Sample Plate using a new tip for each well, rinsing the tip with sample solution.

steps.title: Automated Extraction: KingFisher Duo Prime Run
steps.instruction: Execute the automated extraction program on the KingFisher Duo Prime.

substeps.instruction: Select program MVRI Duo LV 1200ul and load the two plates using A1 markings.
Start the program and close the front lid.
Unload the elution plate, transfer RNA to labeled containers, and store appropriately.
Unload the sample plate, empty contents into a disinfectant beaker, and run the UV disinfection program.

steps.title: Automated Extraction: KingFisher Flex Setup
steps.instruction: Configure the KingFisher Flex for extraction using a 24-tip magnetic head and 24-tip combs.

substeps.instruction: Import the MVRI_Flex_LV_1200ul program and perform a mock run.

steps.title: Automated Extraction: KingFisher Flex Plate Prep
steps.instruction: Prepare processing plates in the clean reagent handling area using multichannel pipettes or an automated multidispenser.

substeps.instruction: Add 900 μl of Wash Solution 1 to plates FW1 and SW1.
Add 1350 μl of Wash Solution 2 to plates FW2, SW2, and Plate Second Wash II.
Place a 24-tip comb in the Tip comb Plate.
Add 90 μl of Elution Buffer or nuclease free water to the Elution Plate.
Transfer 3.6 ml of sample/lysis mixture to the labeled Sample plate in the sample handling area.
Add 60 μl of Bead Mix to the Sample plate wells using a new tip for each, rinsing the tip with sample solution.

steps.title: Automated Extraction: KingFisher Flex Run
steps.instruction: Execute the automated extraction program on the KingFisher Flex.

substeps.instruction: Confirm 24 deep-well magnetic head and heat block are installed.
Select MVRI_Flex_LV_1200ul protocol, load plates, and start the protocol.
Close the front lid.
Upon completion, unload the elution plate and transfer RNA to labeled containers (keep on ice or store frozen).
Remove remaining plates and dispose of them according to laboratory processes.
